title.en: Talking about the Characteristics of a Person

intro: This unit is about describing people — looks, age, height, hair and personality. Grammar: (1) ……，只是…… “…, only/but…” (good point first, drawback second); (2) 既……又…… “both… and…”; (3) reduplicated adjectives (大大的眼睛, 高高兴兴). Translations and answers marked “model answer” were written for this sheet; the listening transcript and its answer come from the book's appendix.

key_sentences.zh: 她很苗条，只是个子不太高。
key_sentences.py: Tā hěn miáotiao, zhǐshì gèzi bú tài gāo.
key_sentences.en: She's very slim, only she isn't very tall.

key_sentences.zh: 我觉得中国女孩儿大都既文静又腼腆。
key_sentences.py: Wǒ juéde Zhōngguó nǚháir dàdōu jì wénjìng yòu miǎntiǎn.
key_sentences.en: I think Chinese girls are mostly both quiet and shy.

body.zh: “只是”是表转折的关联词语，前边通常为积极意义，后边通常为消极意义。例如：
body.en: “只是” is a conjunction indicating transition, usually with the former part indicating positive meanings and the latter part indicating negative meanings, e.g.,

body.zh: （好的方面），只是（不太好的方面）
body.py: (hǎo de fāngmiàn), zhǐshì (bú tài hǎo de fāngmiàn)
body.en: (good point), 只是 (drawback) — “…, it's just that…”

body.zh: 她长得真漂亮，只是个子有点儿矮。
body.py: Tā zhǎng de zhēn piàoliang, zhǐshì gèzi yǒudiǎnr ǎi.
body.en: She's really pretty, only she's a bit short.

body.zh: 今天的天气不错，只是听说晚上有雨。
body.py: Jīntiān de tiānqì búcuò, zhǐshì tīngshuō wǎnshang yǒu yǔ.
body.en: The weather is nice today, but I hear it will rain tonight.
Keep the order: positive first, negative after 只是. “昨天的菜真好吃，只是有点儿少” (tasty, only a bit little) is right; flipping it (“真少，只是很好吃”) sounds wrong. 只是 is softer than 但是/可是.

body.zh: “既……又……”连接结构和音节数目相同或相似的形容词、动词及动词词组。例如：
body.en: “既……又……” is used to connect adjectives, verbs or verb phrases with similar structures or the same number of syllables, e.g.,

body.zh: 既 + A + 又 + B
body.en: both A and B (A and B have the same structure)

body.zh: 他既是我的朋友，又是我的老师。
body.py: Tā jì shì wǒ de péngyou, yòu shì wǒ de lǎoshī.
body.en: He is both my friend and my teacher.

body.zh: 她既热情，又开朗。
body.en: She is both warm and cheerful.

body.zh: 否定形式是“既不……也不……”或“既没……也没……”。
body.en: Its negative form is “既不……也不……” or “既没……也没……” (from the book's self-test explanation).

body.zh: 我在那儿既没吃过意大利菜，也没吃过法国菜。
body.py: Wǒ zài nàr jì méi chīguo Yìdàlì cài, yě méi chīguo Fǎguó cài.
body.en: There I've eaten neither Italian food nor French food.
Both halves must match: 既会说汉语，又会做中国菜 (both 会 + verb). You can't mix a positive and a negative half (✗ 既会说汉语，不会做中国菜), and 没 goes after 既, not before it (✗ 没既吃过).

title.en: Reduplication of an adjective used as an attributive

body.zh: 形容词重叠有加深程度的意思，同时带有一定的感情色彩。单音节形容词重叠形式为“AA”，如“黑黑的头发”，双音节重叠形式为“AABB”，如“高高兴兴”、“漂漂亮亮”。形容词重叠形式做定语的前边不再受程度副词的修饰。例如：
body.en: An adjective can be reduplicated for intensification to show certain emotion. The reduplicative form of a monosyllabic adjective is “AA”, for example “黑黑的头发”; and the reduplicative form of a disyllabic adjective is “AABB”, for example “高高兴兴”, “漂漂亮亮”. If an adjective is reduplicated to serve as an attributive, it is not modified by an adverb of degree preceding it, e.g.,

body.zh: AA的 + 名词 ／ AABB的
body.en: 黑 → 黑黑的头发; 高兴 → 高高兴兴的

body.zh: 她有一双大大的眼睛。
body.py: Tā yǒu yì shuāng dàdà de yǎnjing.
body.en: She has a pair of big, big eyes.

body.zh: 在北京，大龙每天都高高兴兴的。
body.py: Zài Běijīng, Dàlóng měi tiān dōu gāogāoxìngxìng de.
body.en: In Beijing, Dalong is happy every day.
No 很/非常/真 in front of a reduplicated adjective — the doubling already means “very”: ✓ 长长的黑发, ✗ 很长长的黑发; ✓ 非常漂亮, ✗ 非常漂漂亮亮的.

instructions.zh: 根据答句写出问句，然后跟你的同伴对照你们的问句。
instructions.py: Gēnjù dájù xiěchū wènjù, ránhòu gēn nǐ de tóngbàn duìzhào nǐmen de wènjù.
instructions.en: Write questions according to the answers and then compare your questions with your partner.

body.en: Useful question & answer patterns from the book's table (appearance · age · height · hair):

lines.speaker: 外表 Appearance
lines.zh: 她长什么样？——她很高，红头发，非常漂亮。
lines.py: Tā zhǎng shénme yàng? —— Tā hěn gāo, hóng tóufa, fēicháng piàoliang.
lines.en: What does she look like? — She's tall, has red hair and is very pretty.

lines.speaker: 外表 Appearance
lines.zh: 他戴眼镜吗？——他戴一副金边眼镜。
lines.py: Tā dài yǎnjìng ma? —— Tā dài yí fù jīn biān yǎnjìng.
lines.en: Does he wear glasses? — He wears gold-rimmed glasses.

lines.speaker: 年龄 Age
lines.py: Tā duō dà niánjì? —— Tā èrshí'èr suì.

lines.speaker: 年龄 Age
lines.py: Tā yǒu sānshí suì ma? —— Tā bú dào……

lines.speaker: 身高 Height
lines.py: Tā yǒu duō gāo? —— Tā yì mǐ qī bā.
lines.en: How tall is she? — She's 1.78 m.

lines.speaker: 身高 Height
lines.py: Tā gāo bu gāo? —— Tā bú tài……
lines.en: Is he tall? — He's not very…

lines.speaker: 头发 Hair
lines.py: Tā tóufa cháng ma? —— Bú tài cháng.
lines.en: Is her hair long? — Not very.

lines.speaker: 头发 Hair
lines.zh: 他头发是什么颜色的？——深棕色的。
lines.py: Tā tóufa shì shénme yánsè de? —— Shēn zōngsè de.
lines.en: What colour is his hair? — Dark brown.

prompt.en: ______? My elder brother is 26 this year.

answer.en: How old is your brother this year?

prompt.py: ______? Xiǎo'ài yǒu yì tóu hēi fà.

answer.zh: 小爱头发是什么颜色的？

answer.en: What does Xiao'ai look like? (also fine)

prompt.py: ______? Tā zhǎng de yòu gāo yòu shuài.
______? Tā mèimei gèzi bú tài gāo.
prompt.en: ______? His younger sister isn't very tall.

prompt.py: ______? Wǒ de yǎnjing shì shēn zōngsè de.

answer.zh: 你的眼睛是什么颜色的？

instructions.zh: 选择班里任意一人，不告诉你的同伴。通过提问，猜这个人是谁。
instructions.en: Randomly choose one of your classmates without telling your partner. Let your partner guess who he/she is by asking questions about him/her.

lines.speaker: A
lines.py: Tā shì nán de háishi nǚ de?
lines.en: Is it a man or a woman?

body.en: Solo version: think of a famous person and write five questions you'd ask to guess them, using the patterns above (多高, 多大年纪, 长什么样, 头发是什么颜色的, 戴眼镜吗).

instructions.zh: 听录音，根据录音中对人物形象的描述，写出下列五个人的序号。
instructions.en: Listen to the recording. Write the number of each person according to the descriptions you hear.

body.en: No audio here, so read the book's transcript (from the appendix) instead, then match each description ①–⑤ to a photo.

body.zh: ①他50岁左右，个子不高，头发很短，身材有点儿胖，不过他总是笑口常开。
body.en: He's about 50, not tall, with very short hair and a slightly heavy build, but he's always smiling.

body.zh: ②她有一头漂亮的金色长发，眼睛大大的。她个子不高，可是身材很苗条。
body.en: She has beautiful long golden hair and big eyes. She isn't tall, but she's very slim.

body.zh: ③她有一米八，身材特别好，有一头漂亮的黑黑的卷发。
body.en: She's 1.8 m, has a great figure and beautiful dark curly hair.

body.zh: ④他个子很高，身材非常好，有漂亮的小胡须，让人觉得他非常英俊。
body.en: He's tall with a great build and a neat little moustache — he looks very handsome.

body.zh: ⑤她看上去非常年轻，有一头黑色短发，身材很苗条，看起来文文静静的。
body.en: She looks very young, has short black hair, is slim and seems quiet and gentle.

body.zh: 再听一遍录音，然后讨论一下图片中人物的年纪、外貌特点。
body.en: Listen to the recording again. Discuss the age and the characteristics of the appearance of each person in the pictures.

lines.speaker: B
lines.py: Tā dàgài yǒu yì mǐ bā wǔ.

items.picture: A tall man with a small moustache in a smart grey suit, smiling.
A heavy-set middle-aged man with very short hair, grinning and giving a thumbs-up.
A tall young woman with long dark curly hair wearing a crown and a “Miss World” sash.
A slim woman with long blonde hair in a fluffy pink jacket.
A young-looking woman with short black hair in a navy blazer and striped top.

instructions.zh: 看图片，一组学生说出图片中人或事物的优点（至少两个），另一组学生指出其缺点或不足之处加以反驳。
instructions.py: Kàn túpiàn, yì zǔ xuésheng shuōchū túpiàn zhōng rén huò shìwù de yōudiǎn (zhìshǎo liǎng ge), lìng yì zǔ xuésheng zhǐchū qí quēdiǎn huò bùzú zhī chù jiāyǐ fǎnbó.
instructions.en: Look at the pictures. One group of students states at least two of the person's/things' merits and another group retorts by pointing out their demerits.

body.en: Example photo: a smiling young woman with short hair in a black dress.

lines.speaker: B组 学生1
lines.en: Only her eyes are a bit small.

body.en: For each picture: give two merits with 既……又……, then a drawback with 只是……

items.picture: A tall, slim fashion model in an elegant white dress on a catwalk.

answer.zh: 她既漂亮又苗条。——只是有点儿瘦。
answer.en: She's both pretty and slim. — Only she's a bit too thin. (model answer)

answer.zh: 这辆车既漂亮又舒服。——只是有点儿贵。
answer.en: This car is both good-looking and comfortable. — Only it's a bit expensive. (model answer)

items.picture: A smiling older businessman in glasses and a dark suit, hands pressed together.

answer.zh: 他既聪明又热情。——只是头发有点儿少。
answer.py: Tā jì cōngming yòu rèqíng. —— Zhǐshì tóufa yǒudiǎnr shǎo.
answer.en: He's both clever and warm. — Only he's a bit short on hair. (model answer)

items.picture: A touchscreen smartphone full of app icons.

answer.zh: 这个手机既好看又好用。——只是有点儿贵。
answer.en: This phone is both nice-looking and easy to use. — Only it's a bit expensive. (model answer)

instructions.zh: 在正确的句子或合适的答句前打✓，看看你语法学得怎么样。
instructions.en: Tick ✓ the correct sentence or the appropriate answer to check how well you have learned the grammar of this lesson.

question.zh: 他的中国女朋友怎么样？

questions.explain: A reduplicated adjective can't take 非常 in front of it. (grammar note 3)

question.zh: 你会说汉语吗？会不会做中国菜？
question.py: Nǐ huì shuō Hànyǔ ma? Huì bu huì zuò Zhōngguó cài?
question.en: Can you speak Chinese? Can you cook Chinese food?

options.zh: 我既会说汉语，又会做中国菜。
options.py: Wǒ jì huì shuō Hànyǔ, yòu huì zuò Zhōngguó cài.

options.zh: 我既会说汉语，不会做中国菜。
options.py: Wǒ jì huì shuō Hànyǔ, bú huì zuò Zhōngguó cài.

questions.explain: Both halves of 既……又…… must have the same structure (会 + verb, 会 + verb). (grammar note 2)

question.py: Nǐ de lǎoshī zhǎng shénme yàng?
question.en: What does your teacher look like?

options.py: Tā yǒu yì tóu chángcháng de hēifà.

options.zh: 她有一头很长长的黑发。
options.py: Tā yǒu yì tóu hěn chángcháng de hēifà.

questions.explain: No degree adverb (很) before a reduplicated adjective. (grammar note 3)

question.zh: 你吃过那个餐厅的意大利菜和法国菜吗？
question.py: Nǐ chīguo nàge cāntīng de Yìdàlì cài hé Fǎguó cài ma?
question.en: Have you had the Italian and French food at that restaurant?

options.zh: 我在那儿既没吃过意大利菜，也没吃过法国菜，我只吃过那儿的中国菜。
options.py: Wǒ zài nàr jì méi chīguo Yìdàlì cài, yě méi chīguo Fǎguó cài, wǒ zhǐ chīguo nàr de Zhōngguó cài.

options.zh: 我没既吃过意大利菜和法国菜。
options.py: Wǒ méi jì chīguo Yìdàlì cài hé Fǎguó cài.

questions.explain: The negative is 既没……也没…… — 没 comes after 既 in each half. (grammar note 2)

options.zh: 昨天的菜真好吃，只是有点儿少。
options.py: Zuótiān de cài zhēn hǎochī, zhǐshì yǒudiǎnr shǎo.

options.zh: 昨天的菜真少，只是很好吃。
options.py: Zuótiān de cài zhēn shǎo, zhǐshì hěn hǎochī.

questions.explain: 只是 is preceded by the positive point and followed by the drawback. (grammar note 1)

quiz.answer_note: Book's scoring: all right — 太棒了！ (Wonderful!). Missed Q5 — review ……，只是…… (note 1). Missed Q2 or Q4 — review 既……又…… and its negative 既没……也没…… (note 2). Missed Q1 or Q3 — review reduplicated adjectives (note 3).
